author: PapiPug
body: So i've been pvping for a while and I hear w-tapping decreases kb somehow and lets you combo more easily. I don't w-tap because I think it's weird and I don't see many pvpers doing it so I just wanted to know if I should develop a new tactic because over the past couple of weeks i've upped my kill/death ratio by 0.05 using my normal strafe and I'm trying to reach atleast 2.00 so I'm wondering if w-tapping will speed up the process at all.
